evidence.title: Civilian Unemployment Rate
evidence.summary: The snapshotted target change was -0.1 percentage points; it resolved to 'below recent range'.

evidence.title: Unemployment Rate | FRED | St. Louis Fed
evidence.domain: fred, federal reserve bank of st. louis
evidence.summary: This source directly provides the unemployment rates for October, November, and December 2024, which are essential for calculating the monthly change.

evidence.title: December jobs report shows economy added 256,000 jobs to end year
evidence.summary: This article explicitly states that the unemployment rate fell from 4.2% to 4.1% in December, confirming the -0.1 percentage point change.

evidence.title: Economy Adds 227,000 Jobs as Unemployment Edges Up to 4.2 Percent – CEPR
evidence.summary: This source reports the November 2024 unemployment rate at 4.2%, which is the starting point for calculating the December change.

evidence.title: November Jobs Report Shows Payrolls Rebound And Unemployment Rate Rise
evidence.summary: This article confirms the November 2024 unemployment rate at 4.2% and mentions that it was in line with forecasts, providing context for the subsequent December change.

evidence.title: Full text of The Employment Situation : October 2024
evidence.summary: This official report from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics states the unemployment rate for October 2024 was 4.1%, providing a preceding data point for the trend.

evidence.title: November Job Gains Rebound from Disruptions
evidence.summary: This source indicates a rebound in job gains in November, which could influence the unemployment rate trend leading into December, though it doesn't directly state the December rate.

evidence.title: United States Monetary Policy December 2024 - FocusEconomics
evidence.summary: This source indicates that the central bank decreased rates in December 2024. Lower interest rates can stimulate economic activity and potentially lead to a decrease in unemployment, providing a macroeconomic context for the observed change.

evidence.title: November Jobs Report: What to watch for as we close out 2024
evidence.summary: This article sets expectations for the end of 2024, including the November jobs report, which provides a baseline for understanding the December outcome.
